loops.minute_1: First piece placement, learn controls. Observable: descent, rotation, lock.
loops.minute_10: 6–8 pieces placed, early clears. Observable: line flashes, score incrementing.
loops.hour_5: Levels progress, gravity multiplies. Observable: faster pieces, stack precision required.
loops.endgame: Pile blocks spawn row, cannot place. Observable: game-over screen with final score.

games.retention_answer: High-score chasing (asymptotic progression), skill thresholds (level advancement = mastery), competitive leaderboards, infinite variation via bag randomizer.

loops.minute_1: Difficulty select (level 0–9, A-Type), receive first piece. Observable: title screen, game start.
loops.minute_10: Place ~6–8 pieces, early clears. Observable: falling blocks, line clear flashes.
loops.hour_5: Level increases per 10 lines, gravity accelerates. Observable: pieces fall faster, precision required.
loops.endgame: Gravity reaches maximum (level 29+), pile blocks spawn row. Observable: game-over screen.

games.retention_answer: Score progression per level (visible milestone), difficulty ladder (concrete challenges), retro appeal, community tool-assisted speedruns, cartridge high-score persistence.

loops.minute_1: Receive first pair of Puyo, place/rotate it. Observable: pair falling, player placement, gravity.
loops.minute_10: Place ~4–5 pairs, first matches appear, cascade detected. Observable: pairs falling, matches flashing, chain counter incrementing.
loops.hour_5: Campaign/endless mode: complex chain setups, garbage incoming (vs mode). Observable: garbage rows appearing, chain depth, score multiplying.
loops.endgame: Pile overflows top row (loss condition). Observable: game-over screen, final score, chain count, result (win/loss in versus).

games.retention_answer: Chain mastery (skill ladder: 1-chain → 2-chain → deeper chains), competitive tension in versus (immediate feedback), pattern recognition (learned setups reward play), multiplayer garbage mechanic (dynamic difficulty), community tournaments (especially Japan). Players return to build longer chains, compete, or progress.
